requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement mixes a functional action (shut off pumps) with a timing condition (more than 4 seconds). Decomposed into one functional requirement and one quality requirement per Pohl §25.2.

source_fragments: Shut off the pumps if the water level remains above 100 meters for more than 4 seconds.

fields.condition: water level remains above 100 meters for more than 4 seconds

structured_requirements.final_statement: If the water level remains above 100 meters for more than 4 seconds, the system shall shut off the pumps.
structuring_notes: Extracted functional action from concern-mixed requirement. Timing constraint moved to separate quality requirement.

structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall monitor the water level condition for a duration of more than 4 seconds before triggering the shutdown action.
structuring_notes: Extracted timing criterion as a separate quality requirement per Pohl §25.2.
